items.title: Result of Certificate course on Certificate course on Forex and Treasury management (FXTM) held on 13th June 2026. -

Extension of timeline for implementation of provisions of SEBI Circular dated June 15, 2026 on norms for base price, price bands, call auction in pre-open session and Close-out procedure for Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs)
Alignment of SEBI's Cyber Incident Reporting Portal with FIRE Format
IT Resilience Index for Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs)
Acceptance of digitally signed Power of Attorney from FPIs
Enabling sharing of information by KYC Registration Agencies (KRAs) with entities regulated by International Financial Services Centres Authority
Revision of Application Form for Mutual Fund Registration
Modification in the regulatory framework for Online Bond Platform Providers (OBPPs) including measures for promoting ease of doing business
